fields.description: The desk may give a reservation or walk-in discount on this plan (OPERA Rate Code "Discount"). Untick for rates that never take a desk discount.
fields.label: Discount Eligible

fields.description: One of the property's rate categories (Settings, Revenue, Complimentary and house use; OPERA's Complimentary and House Use rate code flags); blank is the property's first. A category can need a manager's sign-off and be left out of ADR, RevPAR or occupancy. Only the property's administrators change it.
fields.label: Rate Category

fields.description: Who last set the plan's category. They never sign off a booking on it.
fields.label: Rate Category Set By
Currency and derived rates
fields.description: The plan's currency and when a foreign contract's exchange rate is fixed; a derived plan prices from its base plan.
Blank: the property's currency. A derived plan uses its base plan's currency.
fields.label: Currency

fields.description: When a foreign-currency contract converts to the property's currency: at booking, at check-in, or at each night's posting date.
fields.label: Exchange Rate Lock

Fixed at Reservation

fields.description: A derived plan takes this plan's price (its card or contract tariff), then applies its own modifier.
fields.label: Base Rate Plan

fields.description: Apply this plan's modifier to extra adult and child charges too. Off: they stay as the base plan prices them.
fields.label: Adjust Extra Person Charges

fields.description: Round the local price to this multiple (for example 1000 for a currency with no cents). 0: the currency's smallest unit.
fields.label: Rounding Step
Day-use billing
fields.description: For same-day stays. Nightly keeps the usual one-night price; Hourly and Block charge from the planned (then actual) times.
Charged per hour on Hourly plans; also used to derive a block rate when Block rate is blank.

fields.description: Length of one sellable block (for example 3, 6 or 12 hours).
fields.label: Block Hours
